answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh dawn challenge every epoch. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra velvet buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. The pulse ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal 198ct.
